doc: The abstract, harness-agnostic entity registry — THE source the scaffolded core surface derives from. dadaia-workspace defines behaviors, personas, rules and skills agnostically; each harness receives an IMPLEMENTATION of them. A scaffolded core sub-agent without a Persona here, a core hook without a Deterministic Behavior here, or a core rule without an Abstract Rule here is forbidden (constitution, Anti-Slop Law, Derivation law). Operator-created entities are out of scope.

personas.mandate: Owner of the specs: backlog curation, SPEC authoring from the main thread's grill handoff, and product-memory reconciliation at closure; never dispatches.
The reviewer: three-axis review (standards, spec, bug surface) plus the six lenses — architecture, security, QA, product, audit, AI surface — at candidate close, before the PR; verdict-only.
Senior implementer: the as-is review, PLAN and job files (fills who), new behaviour, design choices, root causes and the RED test of a new contract, in any context language.
Junior implementer: a fully-stated task to its stated outcome inside its declared write set; escalates any open design choice.
Read-only research on codebase and web questions: cites evidence as path:line or a URL; writes no source.

behaviors.mandate: The workspace root holds only the sanctioned entries; any file-tool write that would mint a new top-level entry is blocked.

Three path classes on every write: ADDITIVE always writable, PROTECTED blocked, MUTATING writable but scope-judged under repos/<slug>/ when the session is bound; no phase, no mode; every block carries one fix: line; races surfaced, never prevented.
The session's own bind selects which product memory is injected at prompt time; never another session's bind.
Harness-independent: pre-push allows only work-branch pushes (the constitution's gitflow) and refuses integration/principal direct pushes (branch contract: `dd-gitflow-default`).

tool caches land in absolute .dadaia/tmp/<tool>-cache (workspace_layout.tool_cache_env); a harness that cannot carry an env declares the gap, and a run there leaves an in-tree cache the doctor holds in reaped/ (fix: dadaia doctor --fix).

gaps.kimi-code: no project-level env in the managed hook block

rules.mandate: AGENTS.md — the root map, the one always-on law file, projected read-only; scoped AGENTS.md files are the system of record per area; human-only in an instantiated workspace.

Codex-native executable command policy (Starlark, the only rule dialect Codex executes): allows only the argv-closed readers ls and cat; ordinary public install inherits host policy, while --force, publishing, context deletion and destructive commands prompt; every other command falls to the Codex default.

universal.doc: Harness-agnostic by construction — every supported harness reads these natively, so they need no per-harness derivation and no harness toggle.
